title: Text QA & Classification
summary: This module provides various model architectures for text-based question answering, sequence classification, token classification, and masked language modeling tasks.

nodes.label: Question Answering Models
nodes.title: Question Answering Models
nodes.description: Models specialized in extracting answers from given text based on questions.

nodes.label: Sequence Classification Models
nodes.title: Sequence Classification Models
nodes.description: Models for classifying entire input sequences into predefined categories (e.g., sentiment analysis, topic classification).

nodes.label: Token Classification Models
nodes.title: Token Classification Models
nodes.description: Models for assigning labels to individual tokens within an input sequence (e.g., named entity recognition).

nodes.label: Masked Language Models
nodes.title: Masked Language Models
nodes.description: Models trained to predict masked tokens in a sequence, useful for general language understanding.
